name: عالم الأحلام -بريق الصداقة
overview: The journey to the dream world is no longer limited to a diamond and its wondrous cat Maysam, but the rest of the friends joined them. In every dream they have, they help someone who has lost their hope and grief, while Hala continues to strive to build her own world of nightmares with the help of grizzling and thunder.
